domain.support: arbitrary sorted unique residues, at most64 nonzero entries
domain.input: canonical exact complex dyadic sparse original vector

point_error: complex absolute error<=2^(-query_bits), rigorously checked from exact dyadic enclosures
accepted_serial_radius: only claimed for a point if p+h-W-(query_bits+3)>=0 and query_bits>=p-c-W+h; required flag rejects otherwise
point_grid: 2^(-query_bits-3); original p-grid numerator represented with symbolic common left shift when nonnegative
roots: exact integer-isqrt half-angle enclosures plus binary character product; O(log N) root table
input_binding: full fresh original-context replay, no reliance on digest collision resistance
paid_cost: setup plus every query plus exports, validation, destination output, source pin/load and downstream processing; no sublinear full-DFT claim
query_logical_arithmetic: O(s log N); m<=64 bounds this factor; bit costs paid separately
full_output_requirement: N queries and N output writes, all charged, unless a separately proved consumer uses exact modal algebra directly
exclusions: arbitrary dense inputs or support discovery
serial recurrence execution or rounded-output equivalence
all p-dependent query radii at bounded numerical precision
full N-row expansion without full charged work
full sparse recovery or outer transfer
